concerns.text: The plan assumes that training two ~5 M‑parameter diffusion models (baseline and student) on a CPU‑only GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM) can be completed within a 6‑hour wall‑clock limit. Given the size of diffusion training loops and the need for gradient accumulation, activation checkpointing, and two separate training runs, this claim is likely optimistic and may exceed the allotted compute budget. Adjust the training schedule (e.g., reduce epochs, batch size) or provide a concrete runtime estimate to ensure feasibility under the free‑tier constraints.
